title: Scientology's claim to sovereign status and its Fair Game program

tellings.quote: And what it is is that they they considered themselves entitled to being considered a sovereign entity because the Catholic Church was.

plain: A lawyer named Dan Sheehan tells Michels that the Church of Scientology believed it was entitled to be treated as a sovereign entity, as the Catholic Church is, and he ties this to what he calls its Fair Game program, a policy the church used against people it saw as opponents. Sheehan speaks as someone who says he dealt with it directly.
